asserts: build_level in numeric mode produces [min, max] per bucket in that column order, over all ten dtypes, for both from_raw=1 (raw samples) and from_raw=0 (tuples), with bucket-relative [min_idx, max_idx] positions, and folds the ragged tail rather than dropping it.
source: tools/_fold.py — the specification's fold in numpy; inputs constructed by tools/gen_set3_build_level.py
contract: Both columns share a type and nothing in the bytes says which is which; the order is pinned because only the format can say it.
notes: ⟢ Column order is [min, max]. Both columns carry the same dtype, so a swapped pair shows only on data where the two differ.
